build_image_processor: build a DeformableDetrImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images and annotations for object detection
run_preprocess_images: run the preprocess method to resize, rescale, normalize, and pad images with COCO annotations for Deformable DETR
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert model logits and bounding boxes into final detected objects with scores and labels
test_prepare_coco_detection_annotation: test prepare_coco_detection_annotation to convert COCO detection targets into Deformable DETR format with boxes and class labels
test_masks_to_boxes: test masks_to_boxes to compute bounding boxes around panoptic segmentation masks in xyxy format
